nuggets.text: The Terriers' 99-degree kickoff against Gardner-Webb was the hottest game ever played at Gibbs Stadium.
Ivory Aikens took a kickoff 97 yards for a touchdown against Gardner-Webb, the fifth-longest return in Terriers history.
Terriers punter Cillian Bonner dropped three punts inside the 2-yard line against Gardner-Webb.
The Terriers' opening win over The Citadel snapped a streak of five straight losses in home openers.
The Terriers and Furman played the first intercollegiate football game in South Carolina, back in 1889.
The Terriers meet Furman for the 100th time on October 3.
The Terriers' campus hosted Carolina Panthers training camp every summer from 1995 through 2023, except 2020.
The Terriers' mascot, Boss, is a Boston Terrier.
Terriers coach Shawn Watson coached Teddy Bridgewater as Louisville's offensive coordinator.
Saturday is the first meeting ever between the Terriers and Kent State.
